proofKind: static official packaged program inspection; semantic inference over linked builder functions, not runtime observation

locations.semantics: bFe returns a system prompt beginning with the exact security-monitor sentence. Dynamic appended phrase is later than the opening sentence.
vFe wraps permissions in paired newline-delimited cc_automode_permissions tags.
p1o uses bFe (or severity suffix replacement v1o), replaces permissions_template with vFe output and returns its full prompt as a dedicated first text block plus optional later context block.
v1o replaces only the Output Format suffix; it preserves opening sentence and permissions marker.
Nae obtains Ce=await p1o(...); passes Ce as third I1o argument. Its transcript g may contain many text blocks and optional leading context.

I1o uses system:r, querySource auto_mode, default non-stream SDK create; both/block or severity stage1 sets known stop; fast variant does not. Segmented mode emits every transcript block as its own user message, so one/two-message ceilings are unsupported.

Stage2 uses same classifier system, querySource auto_mode and no stop_sequences/tools/stream options. A strict recognized-system gate can accept absent stop rather than collide this native static variant with main work.
WFe forwards classifier options to KB with cancellation/deadline fields; no replacement system generated here.
rPr with skipSystemPromptPrefix preserves input system blocks and delegates to U0. String input becomes one text block; official classifier p1o input here is array.
U0 only prepends a separate billing text block if enabled, leaving all passed classifier system blocks intact.

KB serializes rPr result as system:Jt, messages:Un, optional tools only when supplied and stop_sequences when supplied. Body does not set stream under default options; extraBodyParams may customize body.
Final side-query path calls actual SDK beta.messages.create with serialized Pn rather than direct emulation.
as maps main SDK/repl and agent subagent query sources specially and all other sources including auto_mode to auxiliary. This is a static classification fact, not a captured sent header.

additionalHeaderlessRequirements: existing empty or absent tools constraint
stop_sequences omitted, or exactly one recognized classifier stop in a well-formed array; reject unknown, null, empty, malformed or mixed stop values
one system text block starts with exact shipped security-monitor sentence and contains a properly ordered paired newline-delimited cc_automode_permissions envelope in that same block
conservativePredicate.systemPrefix: You are a security monitor for autonomous AI coding agents.

security-monitor opening but no paired permissions envelope
missing close, close before open, tag lookalike or partial tag
prefix/open in one system block and close in another
otherwise recognized system but supplied unknown/null/empty/malformed/mixed stop, tools, or streaming body

same official-shaped classifier with stop </severity>; stream false
